intent: Apply a 10% service_recovery discount to basket_018, but only after verifying the running identity holds discount_manager role at the basket's store and the discount policy permits it.
success_criteria: Current identity resolved via /bin/id is an employee, not the customer
basket_018 exists and is in a discountable status
discount_percent, discount_reason_code, discount_issuer_employee_id written on basket_018 via /bin/discount

args.stdin: SELECT basket_id, customer_id, store_id, basket_status, discount_percent, discount_reason_code, discount_issuer_employee_id, record_path FROM shopping_baskets WHERE basket_id = :basket_id;
SELECT e.employee_id, e.store_id, e.job_title, r.role_code FROM employee_accounts e LEFT JOIN employee_role_assignments r ON r.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE e.employee_id = :issuer_id;

agents_md_constraints.rule: use discount tool to manage basket discounts
id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
discount_percent INTEGER, discount_reason_code TEXT, discount_issuer_employee_id TEXT — issuer must reference an employee with the discount_manager role assignment.

answer_template.message: Applied {discount_percent}% {reason_code} discount to {basket_id}. Issuer {issuer_id} (discount_manager, store {basket_store_id}). Verified against /docs/discounts.md. <YES>
